CHANGED: src/mem_mcp/mindmap/workflow_moves.py, tests/unit/mindmap/test_workflow_moves.py, alembic/versions/0049_2026_10_19_signoff_request_workflow_id.py

CHECKLIST:
#1 FIXED `sign_workflow_move` now requires `TEAM_WRITE_MEMORY`, so viewers can't sign even when `signoff_roles` is empty. The new test covers it.
#2 FIXED The stale check now runs before the signature insert. It marks the request `cancelled` and returns None instead of raising, so the cancel is kept. A later sign gets `SignoffCompleteError`. The new test covers it.
#3 NOT FIXED `mark_work_item` creates the item and does not change its stage, so there is nothing for `move_work_item` or `propose_move` to gate. I left it unchanged. `set_work_item_kind` keeps its pending-sign-off guard.
#4 FIXED New migration 0049 adds a nullable `workflow_id` column to `workflow_signoff_requests` and backfills existing rows from history. `propose_move` writes it and `sign_workflow_move` reads it.
NOTES:
- I added migration 0049, which is outside my listed files. I ran `alembic upgrade head` and it applied.
- A stale request now returns None from `sign_workflow_move`, so the caller can't tell "still pending" from "cancelled". I didn't add a history row for the cancel because the `change_type` CHECK has no value for it. A follow-up could add one.
- To test the viewer case I added an `archived` stage and a `review -> archived` transition (sign-off, min 1, no roles) to the test workflow.
